cohort_note: Berlin collector-reuse trial — the primary strategic question is how many of these sources required ZERO new collector code versus configuration-only reuse versus new reusable platform engineering versus genuinely bespoke per-venue code. See each entry's own acquisition_path_detail and detailed_source_ref for the governed investigation this was proven against.

entries.name: Tempodrom
entries.acquisition_path_detail: One page's own schema.org JSON-LD array holds the venue's entire upcoming schedule. Reusable ingestion/json-ld/ family, zero new collector code — only source registration/URL configuration. Proven live in research/source-investigations/tempodrom-berlin-01/. CORRECTION: this venue's real page emits an unquoted <script type=application/ld+json> attribute, which required a small, backward-compatible widening of the EXISTING ingestion/json-ld/parse.mjs regex (quotes now optional) — genuinely reusable for any future source with the same pattern, but this means Tempodrom itself is honestly CONFIGURATION_ONLY, not pure zero-code, since existing collector code did change.

entries.name: Radialsystem
entries.acquisition_path_detail: Custom-built (ProcessWire) site with a fully server-rendered occurrence-list view; Alpine.js only powers client-side filtering on top of already-rendered HTML. Mixed-discipline programme (dance/exhibition/workshop alongside concerts) — a genuine music-relevance filter is applied (4 of 28 in-scope rows are music). A genuinely bespoke static-HTML parser (ingestion/radialsystem/observation-adapter.mjs) was required. Proven live + offline in research/source-investigations/radialsystem-berlin-01/.

A genuinely bespoke two-step discover-then-fetch-detail parser (ingestion/silent-green-kulturquartier/discovery.mjs + observation-adapter.mjs) was required. entries.name: Tresor
entries.acquisition_path_detail: WordPress with a custom event-grid theme; its own wp-json/tribe/events/v1/events REST route returns 401 rest_disabled (confirmed unusable). List page states no time-of-day; source_record_id uses the detail page's own date-prefixed URL slug (YYYYMMDD-slug). A genuinely bespoke static-HTML parser (ingestion/tresor/observation-adapter.mjs) was required. Proven live + offline in research/source-investigations/tresor-berlin-01/.

entries.name: WABE
entries.acquisition_path_detail: Jimdo hosted site, one hand-built static page per calendar month (no JSON-LD/ICS/API of any kind). Temporarily operating from an interim venue (Schönfließer Straße 7) while its permanent Danziger Straße 101 site is under renovation. No universal stable source-native event ID; a documented deterministic date+time+title-slug alternative is used instead. A genuinely bespoke static-HTML parser (ingestion/wabe/observation-adapter.mjs) was required. Proven live + offline in research/source-investigations/wabe-berlin-01/.

No year is ever stated on the source (start_date stays honestly PARTIAL) and no first-party per-event ID exists (a Resident Advisor ticket-link ID is used only as a non-canonical dedup key, documented honestly). A genuinely bespoke static-HTML parser (ingestion/wilde-renate/observation-adapter.mjs) was required. Proven live + offline in research/source-investigations/wilde-renate-berlin-01/.
